## Pre-flight checklist

- [ ] The repo's pre-push gate passes locally (`/prep-pr`, or the repo's documented test and lint commands).
- [ ] Review pass done; critical and important findings fixed before pushing.
- [ ] Commits are clean and logical before the first push.
- [ ] Docs updated for any user-visible change.
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the diff or the commit messages.
